Odoo Pipedrive Integration

Expose a seamless bidirectional connection between Odoo and Pipedrive. Synchronize Companies (Organizations), Contacts (Persons), Leads, Opportunities (Deals), Products, Activities, Notes, and Files automatically or manually with hash-based change detection.

Key Features

Everything required to synchronize enterprise CRM data between Odoo and Pipedrive.

Bidirectional Contacts Sync
Companies & Persons

Seamlessly synchronize Companies (Organizations) and Contacts (Persons) between Odoo and Pipedrive. Keep partner addresses, email channels, telephone coordinates, and parent-child organizational relationships perfectly matched and updated bidirectional.

Pipeline & Deal Flow
Leads & Opportunities

Map Pipedrive Pipelines and Stages directly to Odoo CRM opportunity stages. Keep sales leads, pipeline boards, status states (won/lost outcomes), and deal values synchronized in real-time, preventing pipeline discrepancies.

Activities & Files

Sync calls, emails, meetings, tasks, notes, and attachment files (PDF/PNG/DOCX). Sales agents see complete historical conversation threads directly in both the Odoo Chatter feed and the Pipedrive Activity Timeline.

Products Catalogue

Expose your Odoo products catalogue directly inside Pipedrive CRM. Synchronize sales pricing structures, standard names, item descriptions, SKU barcodes, tax setups, and multi-currency configurations automatically.

Field & Dropdown Map

Configure custom field mappings. Retrieve custom dropdown menus and mapping structures automatically using the integrated "Import Fields" wizard, ensuring your custom data is preserved between Odoo and Pipedrive.

Hash-Based Deduplication

Compare record hash signatures to detect changes. The connector skips unmodified data to optimize execution times, prevent API quota exhaustion, and execute delta syncs in seconds without database lag.

Cron & ID Sync Wizards

Enable background cron schedulers to automate synchronization runs. Alternatively, execute manual syncs via view buttons or fetch targeted records from Pipedrive using the Record ID sync wizard.

API v2 & Audit Logs

Upgraded to Pipedrive API v2 schema with cursor pagination and owner (User) mappings. Includes a detailed sync logger dashboard in Odoo to audit success states, errors, and raw JSON payloads.

Odoo & Pipedrive Connection Process

Review the exact visual panels showing Odoo settings activation, API token retrieval, configuration setups, dynamic mappings, and sync workflows.

1. Module Activation

Activate the "Odoo Pipedrive Integration" module inside your Odoo database instance.

2. User Security & Group Settings

Configure Odoo user access privileges. Navigate to Settings > Users and set the Pipedrive Integration group to "Odoo Plugin Admin."

3. Pipedrive User Profile

Log into your Pipedrive CRM account, navigate to Personal Preferences from your user profile icon.

4. Retrieving Personal API Token

Under the API section, copy your secure Personal API Token from Pipedrive.

5. Configuring Credentials & Verification

Paste the API token into Odoo's Pipedrive App Token field, enable the Is Connected toggle, and click Test API Connection.

6. Fetching Pipedrive Metadata & Fields

Click the "Import Fields" button to automatically load and map all Pipedrive fields and dropdown models in Odoo.

7. Exposing Synchronized Sub-Modules

View dynamic sub-panels detailing syncing structures for Odoo Companies, Pipedrive Companies, and active customer CRM actions.

8. Setting Ingestion Scheduling and Manual Sync Buttons

Enable the Activate Scheduler toggle to automate backend jobs, or use the manual "Sync Odoo to Pipedrive" action.

9. Dynamic Record ID Wizard Pull

Manually pull targeted items from Pipedrive using the record ID fetcher wizard inside Odoo.

10. Creating Odoo Company Record

Create a new partner company in Odoo and click "Sync to Pipedrive". Odoo maps Pipedrive ID and writes hash key references automatically.

11. View Synced Organization in Pipedrive

Open Pipedrive's organization panel to confirm the synced company profile details successfully mapped from Odoo.

12. Creating Company Profile inside Pipedrive

Create a new organization in Pipedrive CRM, and copy the organization's unique Pipedrive ID.

13. Fetching the Pipedrive Company using Wizard

Launch the Odoo wizard, choose "Company" module, specify the Pipedrive target ID, and run the import.

14. Verified Synced Company in Odoo ERP

Open Odoo Companies directory to verify the imported record, detailing synced Pipedrive IDs and coordinates.

15. Syncing Odoo Contacts (Persons)

Create a new partner contact card in Odoo ERP, and click the Sync Odoo to Pipedrive action button.

16. Person Contact Created in Pipedrive

Verify the newly created Person record on the Pipedrive Contacts panel, including linked email/telephone details.

17. Creating Contacts inside Pipedrive CRM

Create a Person profile in Pipedrive. Go to Odoo and trigger a Pipedrive to Odoo contacts pull.

18. Verified Person Record inside Odoo Contacts

Verify that the Pipedrive Person is successfully created in Odoo with email and parent organization links intact.

19. Syncing Odoo CRM Opportunities

Configure a CRM opportunity in Odoo and sync it to Pipedrive using the background scheduler cron job.

20. Deal Pipeline Created inside Pipedrive

Verify the Odoo opportunity is mapped to a Pipedrive Deal, placed in the correct pipeline stage.

21. Syncing Pipedrive Deal Pipelines to Odoo

Create a Deal in Pipedrive. The Odoo background cron scheduler fetches it and places it in Odoo CRM.

22. CRM Opportunity Created in Odoo ERP

Open Odoo CRM Kanban board to verify the newly synced deal, complete with value metrics and stage mappings.

23. Syncing Odoo Products Catalogue

Create a sales product template card in Odoo ERP, and click the Sync to Pipedrive action button.

24. Verified Product Item in Pipedrive CRM

Open Pipedrive's Products menu to verify the synced item profile, pricing rates, and SKU references.

25. Ingesting Products from Pipedrive to Odoo

Create a product in Pipedrive. Go to Odoo and trigger a Pipedrive to Odoo products pull via wizard.

26. Product Template Populated in Odoo

Open Odoo Products catalog to verify the synced item card containing pricing, codes, and description tags.

27. Syncing CRM Leads from Odoo to Pipedrive

Create a new customer lead card in Odoo ERP, and click the Sync Odoo to Pipedrive action button.

28. Verified Lead Record in Pipedrive CRM

Open Pipedrive's Leads Inbox to confirm the synced lead coordinates, contacts, value details, and hash keys.

29. Verified Record Created in Odoo CRM

Confirm the synced lead inside Odoo Leads pipeline board showing mapped customer coordinates.

30. Appending Files & Attachments inside Pipedrive

Attach corporate PDF files or PNG image screenshots onto the organization's details panel inside Pipedrive CRM.

31. Verified Synced Documents inside Odoo Partner Chatter

Open Odoo company record to verify the imported files appended onto the chatter attachments directory automatically.

Version 2.0.0 – Pipedrive API v2 Upgrade

Complete migration to Pipedrive API v2 (modern schema). Exposes cursor-based pagination and updated v2 payload models for Contacts, Companies, Deals, Products, and Activities.

Key Enhancements
  • Upgrade to Pipedrive API v2 endpoints.
  • Cursor-based pagination for large datasets.
  • Optimized change check using record hash comparison.
  • Two-way real-time syncing for CRM deals won/lost status.
  • Activities, notes, and attachments sync on chatter.
Release History
v2.0.0
Pipedrive API v2 migration, cursor-based pagination, and optimized sync algorithms.
v1.0.0
Initial release for Odoo 15, 16, 17, 18, and 19. Supported manual/scheduled syncs of Leads, Deals, Organizations, Persons, and Activities.
Is this app compatible with both Odoo Community and Enterprise editions?
Yes, this app works perfectly with Odoo Community and Enterprise editions, including Odoo.sh and On-Premise setups.
What Pipedrive data can be synced with Odoo?
This module supports syncing of Companies (Organizations), Contacts (Persons), Leads, Deals (Opportunities), Products, and Activities including Calls, Meetings, Tasks, Mails, Notes and Files (attachments).
How does the sync process work?
You can manually sync individual records or perform bulk operations. Additionally, you can configure automated syncing through scheduled actions (cron jobs).
Is synchronization bidirectional?
Yes, the connector supports bidirectional syncing between Odoo and Pipedrive, ensuring that data remains consistent across both systems.
